examples.arabic: بابا بيقعد في الأوضة و بيشوف الأخبار في التليفزيون.
examples.english: Dad sits in the room and watches the news on the television.
examples.transliteration: Baba biyuud fi el-oda wa biyishoof el-akhbar fi el-television.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: مسكت تليفوني واتصلت بيها عشان أحكيلها كل الأخبار
examples.english: I grabbed my phone and called her to tell her all the news.
examples.transliteration: Masakt telefooni wattesalt beeha ashan ahkeelaha koll el akhbar.

examples.arabic: ايوه انا كويس ايه اخبار اليوم
examples.english: Yes, I am good. What's new today?
examples.transliteration: Aioh ana kwayyes. Eh akhbar el yom?

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية كتير عن اخبار العيلة والبلد
examples.english: We sat and talked a lot about family news and the country
examples.transliteration: Qaʿadnā netkallem shwaya kitīr ʿan akhbār el-ʿēla wel-balad

examples.arabic: شربنا الشاي سوا واتكلمنا شوية عن اخبار عمّها اللي مسافر
examples.english: We drank tea together and talked a bit about the news of her uncle who is traveling
examples.transliteration: Sheribna esh-shay sawa we tkallimna shwaya 3an akhbar 3ammha elli msafer

examples.arabic: خالتي بتحب تتكلم عن الاخبار السياسية وعن رئيس الجمهورية
examples.english: My aunt loves to talk about political news and about the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Khalti betḥebb tetkallem ʿan el-akhbār es-siyāsīya wa ʿan raʾīs el-gomhūrīya.
